objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object that goes through creation, editing, review, release, and archiving processes with versioning and status tracking.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document type that documents locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A document type describing specific detailed procedures and work steps within a framework.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: A document type defining roles, objectives, framework, and process sequences with responsible persons.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document that is automatically released with the main document and has its own versioning but passes through all statuses of the main document's release process.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document supplement not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release process.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A request to amend an existing document without affecting its content or version history until implemented.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: An automated system request created when a document reaches 30 days before its validity expiration date.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document that no longer has validity and must be withdrawn from circulation.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated document during its archiving period.

objs.name: author
objs.description: A user role responsible for creating and initially signing documents with read and write permissions.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A user role responsible for checking document content for technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A user role responsible for approving documents and deciding on distribution to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A user role responsible for translating released document content into other languages.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A user role with read-only access to approved documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of users and user groups assigned to receive notifications and access to a document.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A set of users grouped for authorization and distribution purposes.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A specific user group that retains read access to archived documents after all other authorizations are revoked.

objs.name: version
objs.description: A specific iteration of a document with its own status and release history.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A confirmation action by recipients that they have received and understood a document.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: The action of attaching a new information object with a corresponding document type and optional template selection.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: The action of modifying the document's content using an editing client based on the source format.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: The action of entering standardized and customer-specific attributes and metadata for a document.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The system action of automatically converting an edited document to PDF format.

evts.name: assign_authorizations
evts.description: The action of assigning read and change rights to users and user groups for a document.

evts.name: initiate_release_process
evts.description: The action of starting the 3-step approval workflow consisting of Creator, Review, and Release steps.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: The action of a workflow participant completing their task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: The system action of making a document visible to assigned readers after release.

evts.name: request_validity_extension
evts.description: The system action of creating an automatic request when a document reaches 30 days before validity expiration.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The action of confirming additional validity for a document and updating its valid until date.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: The action of creating a new editing version of a released document while retaining previous data.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: The action of withdrawing authorizations from a document while retaining it in the system.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: The action of invalidating a document and archiving it with revoked authorizations.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: The action of re-validating an archived document and restoring its original status.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: The action of creating a proposed amendment to an existing released document.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: The action of creating a new document version to incorporate an approved change proposal.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: The action of sending email notifications to assigned users and user groups when a document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: The action of requiring assigned users to actively confirm receipt and understanding of a document version.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: The action of a recipient confirming that they have received and understood a document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: The action of translating released document content into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: The action of checking and approving a translated document version through workflow.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The action of approving a translated document to make it visible to readers in the corresponding language.

o2o.description: Documents can reference other documents through maintained attributes.
A document can have one or more attachments that are controlled and released with it.
A document can have one or more additional information supplements.
A change proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific document.
A document can have multiple versions through its lifecycle.
A validity extension request is linked to the document that requires validity checking.
An override request is created for a selected document to invalidate it.
A reactivation request is created to select and re-validate a previously invalidated document.
User groups are assigned to distribution lists to control access and notifications.
An author is assigned to a document and responsible for its creation and initial signing.
Reviewers are assigned to a document for content checking during the review workflow step.
A releaser is assigned to a document and responsible for approving its release.
A translator is assigned to create and review language versions of a released document.

o2e.description: A document is created as an information object with a document type and optional template.
A document's content is modified through the editing client.
A document's attributes and metadata are entered and maintained.
A document is automatically converted to PDF after content is saved.
User and group authorizations are assigned to a document through properties.
A document's release workflow is started by the author or co-author.
A document is automatically published and made visible to readers after release.
A validity extension request is automatically created for a document nearing expiration.
A document's validity is extended and its valid until date is updated.
A new editing version of a document is created when a released document is revised.
A document is archived with authorizations withdrawn except for the archive group.
A document is invalidated and marked out of force through the override process.
An archived document is re-validated and restored to an active state.
A change proposal is created for an existing document without affecting its version.
A new document version is created incorporating an approved change proposal.
A document version is distributed to assigned users and user groups via email notification.
Document recipients are requested to actively confirm receipt of a document version.
A released document is translated into another language.
A translated document version is checked and approved through workflow.
An attachment's content is edited along with the main document.
An attachment receives the same authorizations as its main document.
An attachment is archived with the main document.
Additional information is created as a supplement to a document.
A change proposal is created to propose amendments to a document.
An author electronically signs documents in the creator workflow step.
A reviewer electronically signs documents after completing the technical or formal check.
A releaser electronically signs to approve document release.
A translator creates language versions of released documents.
A reader confirms acknowledgement of a document they received.
User groups assigned to a distribution list receive email notifications of new document versions.
Users in assigned user groups are requested to confirm document acknowledgement.
